title: Motion Branding / Interface overview
slide_intent: Connect small feedback signals to the wider identity because interface actions are also brand encounters.
strategic_value: A telephone icon beside a bar-based indicator can extend DB character into functional feedback.
demonstration: A telephone outline occupies the left panel; a red bar sequence with a white triangular marker occupies a wider dark panel at right. The PNG is a captured animation state.
practical_value: Compare an icon attention cue with a continuous-value indicator before assigning movement to an interface.

content_islands.name: Telephone
content_islands.spec: Keep the dark telephone outline centered on its pale square field.

content_islands.name: Indicator
content_islands.spec: Place the red bars and downward white marker on the wider dark field.

reference_purposes.Expression: The paired interface artwork uses the icon style and Schwelle-derived bars as two distinct feedback expressions.
